note: What deepening COSTS. A checkpoint that offers `deepen` without a price is a status line — the illusion of control — so this table is the reason `lod-transition` may be published at all. Every number starts as an estimate and says so; `dops lod retrain` replaces it with the median of the project's own measured deepenings once there are three of them, and is the ONLY writer of a `measured` entry.
composition_note: Only single steps of the ladder are declared. A two-step jump costs the sum of the steps it crosses, because it is the same work done in one go. Declaring a separate number for every pair would add three more numbers that nobody will ever measure, and an unmeasured number is exactly what this table exists to retire. A sum that crosses even one estimated step is reported as an estimate: a total is only as measured as its weakest term.

scopes.global: the whole product moves up a step
scopes.section: one named scope moves up a step (`section:hero`), the rest stays where it is
